SUPERIOR RETURNS AT LOWER RISK LEVELS REFLECT  
LOWER LEVERAGE AND ENTRY VALUATIONS IN AUSTRALIA
Analysis by IFM Investors of investment valuations and leverage as a proxy for risk shows that in addition to Australian Private Equity 
delivering higher returns historically, it’s also done so with relatively lower risk.
The median entry valuations in Australian Private Equity is significa tly lower than in the US and Europe over an extended period of 
time. This lower pricing contributes to lower debt, a factor helping to reduce investment risk.
Lower pricing and lower debt are factors that have supported Australian Private Equity performance and contributed to Australia 
outperforming all other regions.
